query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!"
           FROM identities i
          WHERE i.org_id = $1
            AND i.kind = 'agent'
            AND i.depth = 1
            AND i.archived_at IS NULL
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                  FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS pattern
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1
                         FROM permission_rules r
                        WHERE r.org_id = $1
                          AND r.identity_id = i.id
                          AND r.action_pattern = pattern))
